name: Sikalastic®-8902
tagline: Polyurethane tack coat for Sikalastic®-827 HT hot melt pellets
summary: Sikalastic®-8902 is a 2-part, polyurethane, transparent tack coat for Sikalastic®-827 HT hot melt pellets
metaDescription: Sikalastic®-8902 is a 2-part, polyurethane, transparent tack coat for Sikalastic®-827 HT hot melt pellets
attributes: Applied by brush, roller or airless spray
Heat resistant to mastic asphalt application
usage: Bonding Sikalastic®-827 HT hot melt pellets on Sikalastic®-851 and Sikalastic®-8800 waterproofing membranes
advantages: Applied by brush, roller or airless spray
Heat resistant to mastic asphalt application

items.label: APPROVALS / CERTIFICATES
items.text: HAPAS Certificate, Sikalastic®-851-8902-827, BBA, Certificate No.15/H237

items.label: Storage conditions
items.text: The product must be stored in original, unopened and undamaged sealed packaging in dry conditions at temperatures between +5 °C and +30 °C. Always refer to packaging.

items.label: Temperature resistance
items.text:
Exposure | Dry heat
Short term | up to +240 °C max.

items.label: Dew point
items.text: Substrate temperature must be min +3 °C above dew point, beware of condensation

items.label: Waiting time to overcoating
items.text:
Minimum waiting time before paving asphalt overlay
Temperature | Minimum | Maximum
+10 °C | 24 hours | 1 week
+20 °C | 16 hours | 1 week
+30 °C | 12 hours | 1 week

items.label: SUBSTRATE QUALITY
items.text: Refer to Sikalastic®-851 or Sikalastic®-8800 Product Data Sheets

items.label: SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
items.text:
Apply Sikalastic®-8902 within the indicated overcoating time of the applied waterproofing membrane. No further substrate preparation is necessary.
If the overcoating time of the applied waterproofing membrane is exceeded, the surface must be prepared mechanically by a light grinding and application of the Sikalastic®-810 adhesion promoter.

items.label: MIXING
items.text: Stir part A for 3 minutes using a low speed single paddle electric stirrer (300–400 r/min). Add all of part B to part A and mix continuously until a uniform consistency has been achieved. To ensure thorough mixing pour materials into a clean container and mix again for at least 1,0 minute. Over mixing must be avoided to minimise air entrainment. During the final mixing stage, scrape down the sides and bottom of the mixing container with a flat or straight edge trowel at least once to ensure complete mixing. Mix full units only. Mixing time for A+B = 4,0 minutes.

items.label: CLEANING OF EQUIPMENT
items.text: Clean all tools and application equipment with Thinner C immediately after use. Hardened/cured material can only be mechanically removed.
